Experimental social psychologist specialising in human-AI social interaction, digital well-being, and ageing with technology. Experienced in preregistered cognitive experiments, large-scale survey analysis, and advanced SEM/Bayesian methods. Skilled in R, Python, and PsychoPy, with cross-cultural experience in the UK and Singapore.

[Master's Dissertation -- The Ethics of Seeing: Contextual Moderation of Altered Image Acceptability]{.h5} [Sep 2024 -- Sep 2025]{.cv-date}

-   Conducted end-to-end research workflow: study setup, piloting, launch, monitoring recruitment progress, and exporting a clean analysis-ready dataset.

-   Conducted complex multi-level Structural Equation Modelling analysis to elucidate key processes behind acceptability of altered images.

::: h3
Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore
:::

[Honours Thesis -- Digital Age and Elderly Well-Being: Internet Use, Social Participation, and Life Satisfaction]{.h5} [Aug 2023 -- Jun 2024]{.cv-date}

-   Integrated concepts from psychology, gerontology, and digital literacy to conceptualize a moderated mediation model to analyse the social mechanisms between internet use and life satisfaction among the elderly.
-   Probed the examination of a new dimension of internet use: "Variety of internet use", and its connections to the proposed model.
-   Executed secondary analysis on the publicly available English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA).
